verdict.rationale: GitCafe has no native AI reviewer that can be assigned to a pull request. The closest path is its official MCP server, which lets external AI tools such as Claude or ChatGPT read pull requests and reviews and, with approval, "work on" pull requests; agent skills and webhooks could also wire up an external reviewer. That makes AI-assisted review possible only by bringing your own agent and integration, and the docs never explicitly say an agent can post review feedback. missing for 10: a built-in or assignable AI reviewer, documentation that an agent can leave PR review comments or approvals, automatic AI first-pass review on PR open, and hands-on or independent corroboration.
